scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @gma/contracts && npm run build -w @gma/domain
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @gma/api && npm run build -w @gma/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @gma/api" "npm run dev -w @gma/web"
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test -w @gma/domain && npm run test -w @gma/api && npm run test -w @gma/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @gma/api && npm run typecheck -w @gma/web
